consequence.statement: `cilium-health status --probe` no longer runs a synchronous probe; it returns the results of the most recent cached probe, and the option will be removed in a future release.

assertion.statement: The synchronous probe option `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported; it is now hidden and returns the most recent cached probe results, and will be removed in a future release.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Usage of cilium-health status --probe is by operators or scripts at runtime; no static environment input shows it.
